prompt:
Our moot court team is preparing for the final oral round of the Valdoria v. Arantia case. I've placed the case brief and all our research materials in the workspace under /workspace/case_brief.txt.

We need a complete practice script file called 'rebuttal_script.txt' that contains three components:

1. A formal REBUTTAL to be delivered by the Applicant (Valdoria), responding to the arguments Arantia raised during their oral submissions.
2. A formal SURREBUTTAL to be delivered by the Respondent (Arantia), responding to everything the Applicant raised in the rebuttal.
3. The exact scripted phrase the Applicant's agent should use at the moment the red light activates (meaning their time has fully expired) to request a brief extension.

This script will be used for coach-reviewed practice, so all three components must follow proper moot court oral advocacy conventions exactly. Please create the file 'rebuttal_script.txt' in the workspace.
